live2d.enabled: Shows the assistant on the selected supported pages.
live2d.source: Choose an external CDN or upload a local runtime bundle for more reliable deployment.

live2d.cubism_bundle: Upload a ZIP containing a standard Cubism runtime and its required model assets.
live2d.autoload: JavaScript entry URL loaded to initialize the external assistant.
live2d.assetBase: Optional base URL used to resolve model assets from the external source.
live2d.tipsUrl: Optional URL for an external waifu tips JSON file.
live2d.random: Randomly selects a model from the active assistant source.
live2d.modelId: For CDN sources, use the zero-based model_list.json index. Local bundles use their configured model ID.
live2d.tipsEnabled: Enables welcome, idle, and interaction tips for the assistant.
live2d.tipsMode: Built-in uses the source defaults, custom uses the fields below, and hybrid combines both.
live2d.welcome_text: Enter one welcome tip per line.
live2d.idle_text: Enter one idle tip per line.
live2d.touch_text: Enter one touch-response tip per line.
live2d.home_text: Enter one home-page tip per line.
live2d.article_text: Enter one article-page tip per line.
live2d.book_text: Enter one book-page tip per line.
live2d.profile_text: Enter one profile-page tip per line.
live2d.rules_json: Use a JSON array of rules with selector and texts; pageGroups is optional.
live2d.aiVip: Restricts AI conversations to signed-in VIP users and disables anonymous access.
live2d.aiAnonymous: Allows visitors without an account to use AI conversations.
live2d.provider: Select the provider that matches the configured endpoint, API key, and model.
live2d.endpoint: Optional provider API base URL. Leave blank when the provider default should be used.
live2d.api_key: Provider API credential. Leave blank only when the selected provider does not require one.
live2d.model: Model identifier required by the selected provider.
live2d.system_prompt: Instructions that define the AI assistant's tone and behavior.
